question: What claim is being made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the one addressed?
premises: This practice of the soul is in view.
It has been told to you.
The address is made to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has now been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of the practice is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
